subject: wo-exp-pri
title: (R)WO.EXP.PRI.------T.C.IMP.
description: Chart on book p. 463 (EXT.F(II)-25). WO-EXP-PRI (world expansion principle) is the subject, with the (R) prefix, "the reality of"; T-C-IMP (time continuum implications) is the partner. From the subject: DYM-SEP (dynamic separation) and TR (transformation). From DYM-SEP: IST-F-AT (isolated focus activism) and RE-DOC (redocumentation). From TR: LK-IMP (linkage implications). From IST-F-AT: RE-ST (restructuralism). From LK-IMP: PRI-INFO (principle information). From RE-ST: GRAD (gradualism). From PRI-INFO: SPT-DY (spiritual dynamics). From GRAD: PHY-U-P (physical universe particular).
